name: HocusFocus
desc: Prevents background apps from stealing focus.
doc: Prevents background apps from stealing focus, while allowing expected user actions like Cmd+Tab, Cmd+Tab+Click, and clicking Dock icons. Useful for keeping your active window focused and blocking focus-stealing apps from interrupting your work.

Method.name: start
Method.doc:
Starts HocusFocus

Parameters:
 * None

Returns:
 * The HocusFocus object

Notes:
 * Begins monitoring for app focus changes.
 * Automatically restores focus to last user-selected window when unwanted focus steal occurs.
notes: * Begins monitoring for app focus changes.
* Automatically restores focus to last user-selected window when unwanted focus steal occurs.

Method.name: stop
Method.doc:
Stops HocusFocus

Parameters:
 * None

Returns:
 * The HocusFocus object

Notes:
 * Stops all focus monitoring and event interception.
notes: * Stops all focus monitoring and event interception.
